apps.localizedDescription:
Accretion signs and installs apps right on your iPhone with your own certificate, no computer needed.

• Browse Accretion Core, Accretion Mods and any AltStore source
• Install from the Accretion web store with one tap
• Rename apps, change icons and bundle IDs, inject tweaks

Built on Feather by claration (GPL-3.0). Source: https://github.com/GETAccretion/accretion-app
